name: 🔑 IAM-04 | Impossible Travel & Login Anomaly Detector

parameters.query:
SELECT src_ip, country, city, login_time
FROM iam_login_history
WHERE username='placeholder'
  AND login_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours'
  AND login_time < NOW()
ORDER BY login_time DESC
LIMIT 1;
INSERT INTO iam_login_history (username,src_ip,country,city,login_time) VALUES ('user','0.0.0.0','IN','Bengaluru',NOW()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

parameters.text:
=🔑 *Impossible Travel Detected — HIGH CONFIDENCE*

*User:* {{ $json.username }}
*Current:* {{ $json.src_ip }} ({{ $json.country }}, {{ $json.city }})
*Previous:* {{ $json.prev_ip }} ({{ $json.prev_country }})
*Time Gap:* {{ $json.time_diff_hours }}hr
*Confidence:* {{ $json.confidence }}%

*Actions:* MFA step-up triggered. Manager notified.
⚠️ Likely credential compromise.

meta.description: Event-driven. Login from 2 countries < 2hr → MFA step-up + alert manager. Uses GeoIP velocity calculation.
